class_example: sakkā nu kho, bho gotama, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye evam'eva anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññapetuṃ?
english_translation: Master Gotama, is it possible, similarly, to describe gradual training, gradual undertaking, gradual progress in this Doctrine-and-Discipline?

class_example: ettha ce n'atthi abhinanditabbaṃ abhivaditabbaṃ ajjhositabbaṃ, es'ev'anto paṭigh'ānusayānaṃ,
english_translation: If here, there is not [something which] should be delighted in, welcomed, clung to. Just this is the end of the underlying tendency towards conflict.

class_example: mātari pitari ca, atho jeṭṭhamhi bhātari. ācariye ca, tesu na mānaṃ karohi.
english_translation: Towards mother and father, and after that, towards the eldest brother; and towards the teacher. Do not show conceit towards them.

class_example: dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā, sabbanimittānaṃ ca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro.
english_translation: Friend, [there are] indeed two supporting conditions for the attainment of the signless liberation of mind: non-attention to all objects and attention to the signless state.

class_example: āhāre paṭikūlasaññāya paricitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato, rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati, upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
english_translation: For a monk frequently remaining with the mind fortified by the perception of the repulsiveness of food, [his] mind withdraws from, bends back from, rolls back from craving for tastes, equanimity or revulsion is established.

class_example: evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
english_translation: When [his] mind is thus collected, [when it] has become pure, bright, spotless, without defilement, pliable workable, stabilized, [and] imperturbable, he inclines [his] mind for the knowledge from the recollection of previous lives.

class_example: saṅkhāresu chandaṃ ca rāgaṃ pajahatha.
english_translation: Abandon interest and desire for volitional formations.

class_example: vivicca kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
english_translation: Having separated from sense pleasures and unwholesome mental states, he arrives at the first stage of meditation and remains there.

class_example: santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
english_translation: That robe cloth [for] an under [robe] and an upper [robe] at the most could be accepted by that monk; if he should accept [robe cloth] more than that, [it is] an offence involving relinquishment.

class_example: yo pana bhikkhu oren'addhamāsaṃ nahāyeyya, pācittiyaṃ
english_translation: whichever monk should bathe within half a month, that is an offence requiring confession.

class_example: seyyathidaṃ — cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañc'indriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjh'aṅgā ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo.
english_translation: [They are] as follows: four foundations of mindfulness, four right efforts, four bases for psychic power, five faculties, five mental powers, seven enlightenment factors [and] the Noble Eightfold Path.

class_example: na sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ek'antaparipuṇṇaṃ ek'antaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
english_translation: It is not easy [for] one domestically settled at home to live the completely perfect, completely pure holy life, polished like mother-of-pearl.

class_example: yaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā, upasaṅkamatu āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessati
english_translation: Indeed, venerable sir, the steward whom the venerable one has indicated has been instructed by me; let the venerable one approach him at a suitable time; he will clothe you with a robe.

class_example: mettāya cetovimuttiyā āsevitāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya ekādasa ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
english_translation: When the liberation of mind by means of goodwill has been practiced persistently, developed, made much of, mastered, made a basis, established, familiarized and energetically undertaken, eleven benefits are to be expected.

class_example: sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthuṃ desanāya pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅghādiseso.
english_translation: If a monk by his own begging should build a hut on a site entailing harm to creatures and not accessible (i.e. not having a surrounding space), or [if] he should not invite monks for allocating a place, or [if] he should exceed the measurement, it is an offence requiring suspension.

class_example: yad eva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
english_translation: Whatever in that regard there is connected with materiality, connected with feeling, connected with perception, connected with volitional formations, connected with consciousness, he sees those states as impermanent, as suffering, as illness, as a boil, as a dagger, as pain, as alien, as disintegrating, as empty, as not oneself.

class_example: seyyathidaṃ — cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañc'indriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjh'aṅgā ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo.
english_translation: [They are] as follows: four foundations of mindfulness, four right efforts, four bases for psychic power, five faculties, five mental powers, seven enlightenment factors [and] the Noble Eightfold Path.

class_example: tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati
english_translation: He obtains faith in the Tathāgata.

class_example: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabb'āsavasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, acchejji taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti
english_translation: Monks, this one is called: "A monk who dwells restrained with regard to all the taints, [who] completely cut out craving, untied the fetter[s], [and] by means of a thorough comprehension of conceit (thoroughly comprehending conceit), made an end of suffering."

class_example: yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññūhi pasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhino saṃvattanikāni
english_translation: Whichever [of] those virtues, which are unbroken, without cracks, not mottled, unblemished, liberating, commended by wise persons, irreproachable and conducive for stability of mind

class_example: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā'ti
english_translation: It is so (thus) "He [is] the Blessed One, the Worthy One, the fully Enlightened One, endowed with wisdom and ethical conduct, Fortunate One, knower of the world, incomparable leader of persons to be tamed, teacher of gods and humans, the Awakened One, the Blessed One."

class_example: samaṇassa ahu vitakko
english_translation: It was a thought of the recluse.

class_example: mettāya cetovvimuttiyā āsevitāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya ekādasa ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
english_translation: When the liberation of mind by means of goodwill has been practiced persistently, developed, made much of, mastered, made a basis, established, familiarized and energetically undertaken, eleven benefits are to be expected.

class_example: so kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena paripūreti
english_translation: He completely fills up the body with joy and happiness produced by seclusion.
